strings.home.description:
Mepee spreadsheet site na kọmputa gị wee gaa n'ihu na Google Sheets.

Mgbe ebubatara ma nyochaa ya, ngwa ahụ na-echekwa nnomi ndabere nke mbụ ma mepụta ụzọ mkpirisi n'ọnọdụ faịlụ ahụ.
